This map uses the official North Carolina State Board of Elections precinct-level results file for the 2024 general election. I aggregated the county totals for the two major-party presidential candidates and mapped the county-level Trump vote share across the state.

```{r setup}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)

zip_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
text_path <- file.path(tempdir(), "results_pct_20241105.txt")

download.file(
  "https://s3.amazonaws.com/dl.ncsbe.gov/ENRS/2024_11_05/results_pct_20241105.zip",
  zip_path,
  quiet = TRUE
)

unzip(zip_path, exdir = tempdir())

nc_results <- read_tsv(text_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## County-level summary

```{r county-summary}
county_votes <- nc_results |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US PRESIDENT") |>
  filter(Choice %in% c("Donald J. Trump", "Kamala D. Harris")) |>
  mutate(County = tolower(trimws(County))) |>
  group_by(County, Choice) |>
  summarise(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(County) |>
  mutate(total_votes = sum(votes)) |>
  filter(Choice == "Donald J. Trump") |>
  mutate(
    trump_share = votes / total_votes,
    winner = "Donald J. Trump"
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(County, trump_share)
```

## Map of Trump vote share by county

```{r county-map}
counties <- map_data("county", region = "north carolina")

county_map <- counties |>
  left_join(county_votes, by = c("subregion" = "County"))

county_map |>
  ggplot(aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = trump_share)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#1f77b4",
    mid = "#f7f7f7",
    high = "#d62728",
    midpoint = 0.5,
    labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 100),
    name = "Trump vote share"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2024 North Carolina presidential election by county",
    subtitle = "Share of the two-party vote won by Donald J. Trump",
    caption = "Source: North Carolina State Board of Elections"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

<div class="panel-card">
  <h3>Read the map</h3>
  <p>The county map shows the general pattern of vote strength across North Carolina in 2024. Darker red counties indicate a larger share of the two-party vote for Donald J. Trump, while blue counties show stronger support for Kamala D. Harris. The layered presentation keeps the information easy to read while maintaining a cleaner depth display.</p>
</div>
